title: Window responds from launch with no startup stall
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

open.issue: The existing stall analysis (tests/window/StallStacks.ps1) shows no stall at startup: partial
SC-050: a drive label with '_' (WD_BLACK, USB_DISK) is drawn as written and gives the window no access key: missing
SC-052: the ready drives' buttons appear without waiting on a drive that does not answer (a mapped share whose server is asleep or offline): missing

Whether the scheduling deserves its own generic file (DriveReads.cs) or should be inlined in LoadDrives. The practice designer flagged its own helper as over-built. It is kept only because it is the one way to prove SC-052 in the default suite without a device.
The 2 s DriveStatus bound: anything between about 0.5 s and 10 s keeps both the hook's 20 s Deadline and the 'never earlier than today' property on this PC. 2 s is a judgement.

Whether Start should refuse to run without a SynchronizationContext, as chosen, or fall back to calling back inline on the read threads, as the proposal did. Refusing makes all state UI-thread-only and the ordering testable on a pump. It also makes every test install a context.
The name-specific pattern of the label rule (`Content = x.Label`): a renamed member evades it. A broader pattern fired on correct code (`Content = panel;` in SettingsWindow.cs).
